extension.summary: Required by the Mistuary skin: server-side search, Douban ratings, playlist completion, file resume and library covers
Mistuary 皮肤的必需组件：服务端搜索、豆瓣评分、播放列表补全、文件播放记录与媒体库封面
extension.description: Required by the Mistuary skin (hard dependency). Search uses the Emby server, so Chinese titles, original titles, full pinyin and initials work like in the Emby app. Douban ratings are read from the StrmAssistant Emby plugin first, falling back to the public Douban API. Playlists are completed by folder, season or next season. File playback resume only records the file manager (10003) and never writes Kodi's native resume point. Library covers are synced locally for the home screen.
Mistuary 皮肤的必需组件（addon.xml 硬依赖）。搜索走 Emby 服务端，支持中文标题、原名、全拼和首字母；详情页豆瓣评分优先从 StrmAssistant 插件读取，失败再回退豆瓣公开接口；播放列表按目录、按季或跨季补全；文件播放记录只记文件管理器（10003）的进度，不写 Kodi 原生续播点；媒体库封面同步到本地供首页使用。
extension.disclaimer: 只在本地读取 Emby 插件的服务器配置，令牌不会写入日志或缓存。
